```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (17.0, 10.0, 22.0),
    "L_in":    (0.25, 0.15, 0.6),
    "gmid_p":  (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),
    "L_p":     (0.3, 0.15, 0.8),
    "gmid_t":  (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),
    "L_t":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),
    "Itail":   (62e-6, 30e-6, 72e-6),
    "R1":      (150e3, 50e3, 400e3),
    "ratio":   (0.117, 0.108, 0.124),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 0.2e-12)
    vdd = 1.8
    It = p["Itail"]
    Ih = It / 2.0

    # NMOS diff pair, PMOS mirror load, NMOS tail mirrored from ibias
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], Ih, vds=0.6, vsb=0.3)
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], Ih, vds=0.9)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], p["L_t"], It, vds=0.3)
    mr = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], p["L_t"], iref, vds=mt.vgs)

    R1 = p["R1"]
    Rf = p["ratio"] * R1

    n = Netlist("vin1 vin2 vout vcm vdd vss ibias")
    # bias reference: iref flows into ibias -> diode-connected nfet
    n.dev("MR", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mr)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # diff pair: M1 gate = vcm (noninverting), M2 gate = summing node
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vcm", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "inv", "tail", "vss", m1)
    # PMOS mirror load, diode on d1 side
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    # feedback network
    n.R("R1", "vin1", "inv", R1)
    n.R("Rf", "inv", "vout", Rf)

    # predictions
    beta = R1 / (R1 + Rf)
    Rl = R1 + Rf
    gout = m1.gds + mp.gds + 1.0 / Rl
    A0 = m1.gm / gout
    T = A0 * beta
    a1 = -(Rf / R1) * T / (1 + T)
    cout = cl + m1.cdd + mp.cdd + 2e-15
    bw = (gout + beta * m1.gm) / (2 * PI * cout)
    power = vdd * (iref + It)
    return n, {"a1": a1, "a2": 0.0, "bw": bw, "vout_offset": 0.0,
               "power": power, "A0_db": db(A0)}
```
